# Browser CAD Editor

A self-contained 2D CAD editor that runs entirely in the browser — no build step,
no dependencies. Just open `index.html`.

## Features

- **Tools**: select/move, line (chained), polyline, rectangle, circle, 3-point arc,
  linear dimension, text
- **Snapping**: adaptive grid snap plus object snap (endpoints, midpoints, centers,
  circle quadrants) with visual markers; Shift for ortho lock while drawing
- **Selection**: click, Shift+click to add, drag right for window select,
  drag left for crossing select; drag a selection to move it, Ctrl+drag to copy
- **Layers**: per-layer color and visibility, entities colored by layer or overridden
- **View**: wheel zoom at cursor, pan with middle/right drag or Space+drag, zoom-to-fit
- **Editing**: undo/redo (100 levels), properties panel (layer, color, circle radius,
  text content/size)
- **Files**: save/open JSON, export SVG, export DXF (R12 — opens in AutoCAD,
  LibreCAD, QCAD, etc.); the drawing also auto-persists to localStorage

## Keyboard shortcuts

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `S` `L` `P` `R` `C` `A` `D` `T` | select, line, polyline, rect, circle, arc, dimension, text |
| `Esc` | cancel current tool / deselect |
| `Enter` | finish polyline (`C` while drawing closes it) |
| `Shift` | ortho lock while drawing; add to selection when clicking |
| `Delete` | delete selection |
| `Ctrl+Z` / `Ctrl+Y` | undo / redo |
| `Ctrl+A` | select all |
| `Ctrl+S` | save JSON |
| `F` | zoom to fit |
| `G` / `O` | toggle grid snap / object snap |
| `?` | shortcut overlay |

## Coordinates

World coordinates are y-up (CAD convention) with the X axis drawn red and the
Y axis green. The grid adapts its spacing to the zoom level in 1-2-5 steps.

## Files

- `index.html` — page layout
- `style.css` — dark UI theme
- `app.js` — all editor logic (entities, tools, snapping, rendering, export)
